mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_audit_log ( tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, operator_type, operator_id, action_code, result, login_method, device_summary, trace_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.subjectType}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{entity.subjectType}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{actionCode}, 'SUCCESS', #{entity.loginMethod}, LEFT(CONCAT(#{entity.deviceType}, ' / ', #{entity.deviceName}), 256), #{traceId}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{entity.subjectId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, operator_type, operator_id, action_code, result, login_method, failure_reason_code, masked_mobile, device_summary, trace_id, occurred_time FROM public.auth_audit_log WHERE ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
